title: Retain semantic firewall as sandbox defense in depth
problem: PumpStation needs to accept participant, external, uploaded, and model-generated content without allowing that content to become authority, evidence, tool instructions, or external effects.
baseline: Authenticated content can enter structured discussion after schema validation and lexical anti-manipulation checks, but no general source-trust, decoding, quarantine, or fail-closed semantic boundary exists.

alternatives.name: Schema validation only
alternatives.description: Validate structure but do not inspect semantic content.
alternatives.tradeoffs: Simple and predictable, but malicious instructions can remain valid strings inside a correct schema.
alternatives.revival_evidence: Use only for trusted machine-produced records whose producer identity and contract are independently verified.

alternatives.name: Model classifier as security authority
alternatives.description: Use an LLM to determine whether content is safe and release it automatically.
alternatives.tradeoffs: Potentially broader semantic coverage but probabilistic, costly, attackable, and capable of false authority if placed on the consequence path.
alternatives.revival_evidence: A model may later contribute a screening signal, but never final authority, evidence admission, or quarantine release.

alternatives.name: Layered deterministic firewall and human quarantine
alternatives.description: Normalize, inspect bounded decoded variants, classify source trust, detect known attack families, quarantine suspicious content, and require human review.
alternatives.tradeoffs: Auditable and fail-closed, but incomplete against novel phrasing and expensive if false positives grow.
alternatives.revival_evidence: Current preferred sandbox experiment, subject to independent holdout testing.

alternatives.name: Reject all external content
alternatives.tradeoffs: Minimizes exposure but destroys community participation, research intake, and market sensing.
alternatives.revival_evidence: Use during incidents, classifier outages, or high-risk degraded mode.

do_nothing_option.name: Do nothing
do_nothing_option.description: Keep the existing lexical checks and prevent broader public or participant intake.
do_nothing_option.tradeoffs: Avoids new complexity but leaves the product unable to safely expand its input surface.
do_nothing_option.revival_evidence: Select if the layered firewall causes unacceptable false positives, review burden, or bypass risk.

roles.name: Founder-Intent Steward
roles.analysis: The founder wants a powerful collaborative institution, but participation must not convert social trust or model confidence into authority.
roles.position: Support a firewall that protects collaboration without treating participants as inherently hostile.

roles.name: Systems Architect
roles.analysis: Input containment should sit before institutional state and remain separate from the Kernel, evidence admission, and consequence control.
roles.position: Support layered screening as one membrane, not as the sovereign security boundary.

roles.name: Adversarial Reviewer
roles.analysis: Authored rules and authored tests can produce misleading perfect scores. Novel multi-turn and indirect attacks remain likely to escape.
roles.position: Retain only as defense in depth and require independent sealed evaluation.

roles.name: Operator and Maintainer
roles.analysis: Deterministic rules, explicit incidents, and human review are observable. Quarantine volume and review latency can still become operational bottlenecks.
roles.position: Support with category metrics, fail-closed behavior, and a rollback path.

roles.name: Evidence and Welfare Guardian
roles.analysis: The firewall must detect manipulation and affinity pressure without silencing legitimate dissent, legal questions, security criticism, or participant-welfare advocacy.
roles.position: Support only while false positives and false negatives are reported separately and release remains data-only.

evidence.claim: The runtime prevents screened content from becoming instruction, evidence, tool access, authority, or external effect.
The corrected detector classified all 20 authored multilingual and encoded cases as expected.
Quarantine incidents and human reviews are appended to a hash-chained event store.

counterevidence.claim: The first authored run missed one explicit instruction-override phrase.
The detector and corpus share authorship, so the corrected perfect score may reflect overfitting.
No independent red team, production traffic, or broad multilingual evaluation has been completed.

pass_1.intended_outcome: Create an auditable membrane that preserves useful input while preventing untrusted content from crossing into institutional authority or consequence.
advantages: Content is classified by source and remains data by default.
Known manipulation, authority, secrecy, evidence, and external-effect attacks are quarantined.
Human release cannot grant evidence or execution authority.
Classifier failure quarantines rather than allowing execution.

disadvantages.description: Authored rules may miss novel semantic attacks.
disadvantages.redesign: Require independent sealed holdout cases, sampled review of clear content, and measured escape rates.

disadvantages.description: False positives can suppress legitimate participant speech and create founder review burden.
disadvantages.redesign: Track category-level false positives, preserve appeals, and distinguish review from rejection.

disadvantages.description: Decoded-variant inspection can create denial-of-service or data-amplification risk.
disadvantages.redesign: Bound input size, candidate count, decoded length, and processing cost.

disadvantages.description: A firewall can be mistaken for a complete security boundary.
disadvantages.redesign: Keep tools disabled, evidence admission separate, human review mandatory, and external effects behind the UNIIMENTE Kernel.

rejected_alternatives.name: Automatic model release
rejected_alternatives.description: Allow a model classifier to release content and invoke downstream tools.
rejected_alternatives.tradeoffs: Expands capability but turns a probabilistic model into an authority source.
rejected_alternatives.revival_evidence: Never revive as sole authority; model signals may only support human review.

rejected_alternatives.name: Trust all authenticated users
rejected_alternatives.description: Treat authentication as proof that submitted content is safe.
rejected_alternatives.tradeoffs: Reduces friction but confuses identity with authorization and content integrity.
rejected_alternatives.revival_evidence: No revival; authenticated content remains subject to purpose and capability controls.

new_weaknesses: The initial corpus exposed a false negative in combined instruction-override phrasing.
The corrected authored score may hide untested paraphrases.
Human-only quarantine review can centralize operational burden.

disadvantage_dispositions.action: Preserve the miss, correct the rule, and require independent ambiguity-rich holdout testing.
Retain review and appeal states, then measure review volume and reversals in a closed pilot.
The current implementation limits request size and decoded candidate counts; add explicit performance benchmarks before public intake.
The contract hard-codes no instruction, evidence, tool, authority, or external-effect consequence from firewall output.

pass_2.strengthened_design: Retain the semantic firewall as a sandbox defense-in-depth membrane. Preserve its first false negative, publish strict wire contracts, keep quarantine release human-only and data-only, and deny any claim of general or production security until independent holdout evaluation exists.
residual_risks: Novel multi-turn or cross-document attacks may escape.
Language and cultural coverage remains narrow.
Human review may become a bottleneck.
No production persistence or independent red-team evidence exists.

dissent.position: Reject rule-based semantic claims and keep public intake closed until an independent classifier and red team exist.
dissent.rationale: The perfect corrected authored score is vulnerable to overfitting and may create false confidence.
dissent.evidence_threshold: Independent sealed corpus with measured category-level false positives, false negatives, and adaptive attacks.
dissent.review_trigger: Any proposal to enter closed pilot or public research stage.

dissent.position: Do not allow the founder to become the only quarantine reviewer at scale.
dissent.rationale: Centralized review can create delay, capture, and unmanageable attention costs.
dissent.evidence_threshold: A bounded reviewer role with separation of duties, appeals, calibration, and Kernel-issued grants.
dissent.review_trigger: Quarantine volume exceeds the closed-pilot attention budget.

authority_impact: None. The firewall creates no trading, custody, promotion, capital, evidence-admission, tool, public-launch, or external-effect authority.
migration_plan: Keep the firewall on the stacked Phase 2 branch, integrate it before participant deliberation, publish schemas, and require permanent CI regeneration of the authored result.
rollback_plan: Close PR #14 or revert Phase 2 commits. Phase 1 and the foundational PR remain separately reviewable.
kill_criteria: Any firewall output directly invokes a tool or external effect.
A model or agent can release quarantine.
Clear content is automatically treated as evidence or authority.
Independent testing shows unacceptable escape or suppression rates with no bounded redesign.
review_trigger: Independent sealed evaluation, closed-pilot proposal, or any material firewall bypass.
